loadout.name: T10 Demolitionist Tank
loadout.notes:
Transcribed from a phone photo of a Reddit screenshot ("this dude tanked a T10 for us"), so only what the photo shows clearly is recorded. Everything else is left empty rather than guessed.

Cores: Armor on the mask, backpack and chest; Skill Tier on the gloves, holster and kneepads. The mask, backpack and chest each carry a mod. The backpack's talent is Combined Arms.

Still to identify: the brands of the mask, backpack, chest, gloves and kneepads (the backpack, gloves and kneepads share one logo, so likely three pieces of one brand — possibly Hana-U Corporation, whose named Force Multiplier backpack carries Perfect Combined Arms), the first skill (possibly a Shield), and the remaining talents and attributes.

The original is heavily invested in Quantum Prototype upgrades, which this view does not record.

The sidearm may be the named TDI "Kard" Custom rather than a plain Kard-45; the photo's card frame matches the high-end HK GR9, so it is recorded as high-end.
